title: This will not replace your fine china
text:
This will not replace your fine china. These Everyday White plates by Fitz and Floyd have a beaded ring design and mimics the look of many higher end plats that you may find from Sur La Table or some such. They are 10.5 inch in diameter which makes it good as a dinner plate for a steak dinner. It's big enough to plate a steak with a side of vegetables.

In terms of build quality, these plates are somewhat thin, if the aim is to use these plates in a fancy dinner party, they don't quite fit the bill. For everyday home dinners, these will do just fine. The center of the plates have a peak so the plates aren't completely flat and when stacked together, you will see that the edges aren't completely flat either. You will see that the rim of the plates are a little bit wavy.
